art.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW six-panel comic illustration in a STRICT 3 columns by 2 rows grid, equal square panels, landscape 1536x1024, thin black gutters exactly at one-third and two-thirds width and halfway height. NO letters, labels, captions, speech bubbles, typography, logos or watermarks anywhere. Original expressive manga Sunday-comic drawing, rich warm wooden workshop, ink outlines, luminous painted shading, same quality and identities as the reference illustrations. Every panel has different framing, strong readable action, upright heads except action, varying front/profile/three-quarter views. Hugo adult short brown hair, trimmed beard, bright blue-green eyes, loose trousers and cream sneakers. iAstro is a little boy android with human face, spiky black hair, cyan temple and cyan heart, white tunic, purple shorts and white/purple boots. Preserve faces strictly. Keep Hugo usually on left and iAstro on right where both appear. Images supplied are ONLY character/style/wardrobe reference, never copy their layouts or lettering. October clothes: Hugo rust orange overshirt black shirt baggy trousers small pumpkin pin, iAstro short purple cape white tunic purple shorts. Autumn laboratory adventure, lanterns and foliage. Panel 1 Hugo has an enormous tangled ball of colored cables nearly taller than him, iAstro surprised. Panel 2 iAstro points at a new glowing blue workshop lab behind a closed transparent gate, with a small badge key reader and NO LETTERS. Panel 3 overhead inside imagined lab: intricate cable paths on a vast workbench, one path highlighted cyan, duo trace the route. Panel 4 close-up: iAstro carefully finds a broken cable connector with magnifier, Hugo holds light. Panel 5 outside lab again: iAstro has a small visitor badge while Hugo waits at the gate politely, emphasizing restricted access. Panel 6 payoff wide: their giant science problem solved on the table but Hugo discovers his own phone charging cable tied in a tiny impossible knot in his pocket, iAstro amused.
